title: Blackstone Canal Heritage Highway
direction: Follows the mapped byway from Grafton to Blackstone.

moments.title: Grafton Common
moments.text: Old homes and churches stand around the common, which got its bandstand from a 1930s film crew and has rebuilt it many times since.

moments.title: Blackstone River and Canal Heritage State Park
moments.text: Canal boats tied up overnight in Uxbridge on the two-day run to Providence, and near Goat Hill a granite lock and the old towpaths are still there to find.

moments.title: Millville
moments.text: Route 122 runs along the river as the town's main street, past a well-preserved lock left from the canal.
